description: This file defines the AggregationParams class, which encapsulates parameters for data aggregation, including interval type, time zone, and aggregation type, with methods for creating instances with specific configurations and calculating interval durations.

classes.name: AggregationParams
classes.description: A class representing parameters for data aggregation, including interval, time zone, and aggregation type, with utility methods for configuration.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Creates an AggregationParams instance with no aggregation and default settings.

methods.name: milliseconds
methods.description: Creates an AggregationParams instance with a specified aggregation type and interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: calendar
methods.description: Creates an AggregationParams instance with calendar-based interval and specified time zone, either by string or ZoneId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an AggregationParams instance with specified aggregation, interval type, time zone, and interval duration.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration in milliseconds based on the interval type or custom interval.

methods.name: getZoneId
methods.description: Converts a string time zone ID to a ZoneId object, with fallback to system default on failure.
